text: The Clarus system design must address how best to minimize these times to optimize the flow of data in a timely manner.
The CAUI shall enable administrators to manage contributor metadata.
The Clarus system shall collect pavement-related observations.
The Clarus system shall accept data through a Clarus standard interface.
The EMC shall be able to maintain contact info for each contributor, collector, and station sensor.
The QEDC combined from all available Clarus hosts shall support 470 million current observations.
The Clarus system shall allow users to create a data subscription request.
The SS shall be able to initiate a QEDS response.
